environment.description: Quarkus 3.2 native image running on AWS Lambda with custom runtime, Amazon Linux 2023 base, JavaMail 1.6.2 (jakarta.mail 2.0.1 shaded), connected to internal Postfix relay at smtp.internal:587. No input sanitization middleware. Lambda function URL with AuthType NONE. Default seccomp profile (docker/default) which permits all standard syscalls including socket, connect, sendto.
